source.author: cic
source.text: O scelus, o portentum in ultimas terras exportandum!
source.text_original: O scelus, o portentum in ultimas terras exportandum!
source.text_english: O crime, O monster fit to be carried away to the ends of the earth!

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: consurgent proceres et aduersum epistulam meam turba patricia detonabit me magum, me seductorem clamitans et in terras ultimas asportandum.
reuse.text_original: consurgent proceres et aduersum epistulam meam turba patricia detonabit me magum, me seductorem clamitans et in terras ultimas asportandum.
reuse.text_english: The nobles will rise up, and the patrician crowd will thunder against my letter, shouting that I am a sorcerer, that I am a deceiver, and that I am to be carried off to the ends of the earth.
